# PDF Quick Tools

PDF Quick Tools is a free browser-based PDF utility platform. Non-AI PDF tools process files locally in the browser, so the original file is never uploaded. AI tools extract text in the browser and send it to the site's AI endpoint (Google Gemini, falling back to Groq) only when you run an AI action.

## Main pages

- [Home](https://pdfpilot.site/): Free online PDF tools.
- [All tools](https://pdfpilot.site/tools): Browse all PDF utilities.
- [About](https://pdfpilot.site/about): What the project is and what it stands for.
- [Privacy Policy](https://pdfpilot.site/privacy): Data handling and advertising disclosure.
- [Terms of Use](https://pdfpilot.site/terms): Usage terms.
- [Disclaimer](https://pdfpilot.site/disclaimer): Accuracy and liability notes.
- [Contact](https://pdfpilot.site/contact): Contact information.
